entry.title: Tennessee governor halts executions after Christa Gail Pike survives lethal injection
entry.summary: Tennessee officials were unable to put Christa Gail Pike to death Wednesday for a 1995 murder after administering two doses of a lethal drug. Tennessee Gov. Bill Lee halted the remaining execution for the year.

entry.title: Leaning into culture war flashpoints, Hegseth says he has transformed U.S. military
entry.summary: Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth told hundreds of junior military officers and enlisted leaders on Wednesday that the Trump administration has achieved a cultural shift in the military.

entry.title: Massachusetts residents compete to be the 'Voice of Logan' airport
entry.summary: A contest is giving Massachusetts residents a chance to become the new voice of Boston Logan International Airport. With thousands of entries, the competition is wicked steep.

entry.title: Police questioning can shape a sexual assault case. Their approach is often wrong
entry.summary: The Cornell lawsuit filed by a woman alleging a brutal rape raises questions on how police handle such cases. The majority of police lack adequate training on trauma-informed approaches, experts say.

entry.title: FBI hunting the hackers who stole its employees' sensitive data
entry.summary: The FBI says it's addressing a massive data breach, vowing to go after the hackers it believes are responsible.

entry.title: A startup wants to build a massive nuclear-powered data center on public land in Utah
entry.summary: Valar Atomics wants to place over 450 reactors on more than 9,500 acres in Utah to power a huge data center project.

entry.title: The moment you've been waiting for: America's best student podcasts
entry.summary: We've listened to nearly 1,500 podcasts from all around the U.S. and narrowed them down to 10 middle school and 10 high school finalists.

entry.title: The U.S. military withdraws from Iraq over 2 decades after its invasion
entry.summary: 23 years after the United States military invaded Iraq, sparking an insurgency and a civil war, the U.S. has withdrawn its forces, as the country still tries to combat Iranian influence.
